name: The Genius Girl Who Oustmarted Her Sheming Sister
original_name: The Genius Girl Who Oustmarted Her Sheming Sister
overview: After being acknowledged by the Morales family, Laura Serrano achieved the highest exam score in the capital, sparking conflict with their adopted daughter, Valeria Morales. Faced with prejudice, jealousy, and manipulation, she stood up for her academic dreams, refused to be used, exposed the family's hypocrisy, supported her peers, and ultimately found the strength to build an independent life.
